title: Kissed Spicy Mediterranean Lamb Tagine
description: A cultured and pillowy date night Mediterranean dish featuring spicy jerk and ferment kimchi flavors in a halal friendly recipe, served in a copper mug.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the jerk seasoning, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the spice mixture all over the lamb shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat the olive oil in a large copper mug over medium high heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until it is browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger, and kimchi to the copper mug, stirring to combine.
Add the dates to the copper mug, stirring to combine.
Cover the copper mug with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the lamb tagine for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and falls apart easily.
Remove the copper mug from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
